Vietnam's capital keeps it real with narrow streets, motorbike chaos, and street food that costs pennies. It's more traditional than Ho Chi Minh, more manageable than Bangkok, and the hostel scene is legendary. From Old Quarter mayhem to Halong Bay trips, Hanoi's your gateway to northern Vietnam adventures. 🏠 Where to Stay in Hanoi Hanoi hostels cluster around Old Quarter with rooftop bars. Hostelworld.com has over 132 Hostels in Hanoi — backed by 52139 traveller reviews. Expect: Old Quarter dorms with AC and rooftop hangs Halong Bay cruise bookings, food tours, and Sapa trek planning Communal dinners, pub crawls, and travel route swapping Staff who help navigate train tickets and border crossings Your Hanoi hostel is your Vietnam adventure headquarters — and where you'll plan your northern loop with new friends. 🏆 Top Hostels to Stay in Hanoi in 2026 These spots get consistent love from Hostelworld.com travellers: Lake View Backpackers Hostel Rooftop Bar – ★ 9.6/10 – Lake View Backpackers Hostel Rooftop Bar The One Hostel & Rooftop Pool Hanoi – ★ 9.8/10 – The One Hostel & Rooftop Pool Hanoi 🗺️ Neighbourhoods to Explore Old Quarter – Backpacker central, street food heaven, and constant chaos French Quarter – Colonial architecture, upscale restaurants, and Opera House West Lake – Expat area with cafés and quieter vibes Ba Vi – Day trip to mountains and minority villages Pro tip: Book Halong Bay tours through your hostel. They get deals and can vouch for quality. 🛵 Getting Around Hanoi From the airport: Minibus to Old Quarter or Grab Walk: Old Quarter is walkable chaos. Watch for motorbikes EVERYWHERE Grab: Cheap motorbike or car rides across the city Bus: Exists but Grab is easier and cheap Cyclo: Tourist rickshaws for sightseeing (negotiate price first) 💬 Why Hanoi? With 52139 reviews from Vietnam veterans, Hanoi is where travelers fall for Southeast Asia. It's chaotic but manageable, cheap but high-quality, traditional yet energetic. Your hostel rooftop becomes the nightly gathering spot where everyone swaps Halong Bay stories over cheap beers. "Hanoi was Vietnam perfection. Street food blew my mind, Halong Bay cruise was epic, and my hostel became family. Northern Vietnam's energy is different — in all the best ways." — Laura, France Want more options?
